single_stage.name: disconnected_immutable_origin_bound_exact_control_validation
ordered_steps: retain exact fresh-audit decision and digest sidecar
lock the running image, header, complete seal, every V15 input, six V14 rejection-closure subjects, Python DLL, and stdlib zip
prove regular non-reparse exact final paths, sizes, SHA-256 values, and FILE_ID_INFO for every retained handle
reserve append-only write-through evidence and one terminal receipt before Python
delayed-load only the retained Python DLL and initialize isolated mode with only the retained stdlib zip
compile V15 twice into private dictionaries and recursively seal every function, class member, referenced value, static namespace field, and static path field
independently compile V14 twice and retain its complete immutable native creation-time graph signature
invoke one stored V15 factory with the exact six native attestation rows and exact native creation-time V14 graph
require one recursively immutable built-in tuple whose attestation and graph objects are the original native inputs
exact-type the loader tuple and every default-off authority Boolean
recheck all V15, V14, V13, private-graph, private-V12, normal-V12 module slots and both Core and V12 parent-package attributes before and after calls
destroy all private dictionaries and result objects, finalize Python, FreeLibrary, prove module/path absence, recheck every retained handle, write one terminal record, and stop

v14_blocker_closure.mutable_snapshot: No snapshot class or writable slots exist; the only result is a recursively immutable exact built-in tuple.
v14_blocker_closure.origin_binding: Result attestation rows and complete V14 graph are identity-and-value compared to native creation-time inputs.
v14_blocker_closure.loader_graph_exact_types: Loader state is an exact five-element built-in tuple and the complete graph is recursively exact typed, not positive-count or equality-spoof validated.
v14_blocker_closure.mutable_graph_fields: Static import namespace and static path slot values are recursively serialized into both same-identity and cross-compile graph signatures.
v14_blocker_closure.package_slots: V15, V14, V13, private graph, private V12, normal V12, Core attributes, and the V12 parent attribute are checked pre/post.
v14_blocker_closure.canonical_config: V15 config is duplicate-rejecting and must byte-equal sorted-key minimal UTF-8 canonical JSON plus one LF, with exact semantic types and fixed predecessor values.
